request.query: evaluating translated multivariate polynomial P(X + alpha) at x equals evaluating P at x + alpha

items.name: Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] (t : R) (a : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC t) a = (Polynomial.aeval (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t)) a

items.name: Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC
items.type: {R : Type u_3} → [inst : CommRing R] → R → Polynomial R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_cast_comp
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) (c : ℤ →+* R) (g : τ → R)
  (p : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), MvPolynomial.eval₂ c (g ∘ f) p = MvPolynomial.eval₂ c g ((MvPolynomial.rename f) p)

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_toMvPolynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (f : σ → S) (i : σ) (p : Polynomial R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval f) ((Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i) p) = (Polynomial.aeval (f i)) p

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_rename
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (k : σ → τ) (g : τ → R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval g) ((MvPolynomial.rename k) p) = (MvPolynomial.eval (g ∘ k)) p
